envelope.title: Clear Street cover letter — research, keywords, and gaps
envelope.intro: I've done the company research, parsed the JD from report 009, and pulled your CV/profile. Before drafting I need your sign-off on three things. (Step 6's four prompts come in the next batch.)

fields.label: Here's what I found about Clear Street — correct or add anything before I write the letter.
fields.help: Clear Street is a cloud-native capital markets infrastructure firm (~$12B valuation, cash-flow positive) replacing legacy clearing/custody rails. In 2026 they shipped a retail trading app (May), spot crypto, prediction markets (Kalshi), a private-markets/pre-IPO platform (Databricks), and expanded electronic execution across Europe/APAC (Aug 25). All of it sits on one real-time ledger with Omni AI, an in-house research engine, plus an MCP server so Claude/Gemini can plug into the platform. This role builds the AI-native active-trader experience on top of that infrastructure. Edit or accept.
fields.default: Clear Street is a cloud-native capital markets infrastructure firm (~$12B valuation, cash-flow positive) replacing legacy clearing and custody rails. In 2026 they shipped a retail trading app, spot crypto, prediction markets (Kalshi), a private-markets/pre-IPO platform (Databricks), and expanded electronic execution across Europe/APAC. All of it sits on one real-time ledger with Omni AI, an in-house research engine, plus an MCP server so AI assistants can plug into the platform. This role builds the AI-native active-trader experience on that infrastructure.

fields.label: Keywords I'll mirror from the JD — anything missing or wrong?
fields.help: I'll weave these in once each, using their vocabulary but keeping the content from your CV.
fields.default:
ATS-critical: AI-native, React, React Native, TypeScript, Rust services, Postgres, streaming answers, data-dense product surfaces, low-latency, real-time

Language/human trust signals: grounded citations, uncertainty signaling, pre-trade confirmations, high-information-density views, order entry, positions/holdings, blotter, watchlists, alerts, own, drive

fields.label: Gap: the JD lists Rust under the stack (backend services are Rust) — you have no professional Rust. How do you want to handle it?
fields.help: JD lists Rust as a bonus/stack element, not a hard requirement. You have strong backend Node.js/Python and SQL optimization depth, and a record of picking up languages fast (Flutter/Dart from scratch at UBA).
options: Address it briefly and confidently (framed as adjacent backend depth + fast learning)
Don't mention it — let the application speak for itself
Tell me your angle and I'll write it your way

fields.label: Gap: no direct trading/margin/asset-class domain experience. How do you want to handle it?
fields.help: You have fintech-adjacent depth: UBA mobile banking rebuild, Tessian SecOps/compliance tools, high-stakes financial data where accuracy and UX alignment matter.
options: Address it briefly (fintech-adjacent high-stakes financial data)
Don't mention it — let the application speak for itself
Tell me your angle and I'll write it your way

fields.label: Gap: notice period. Your profile shows a 30-day notice period. Confirm the figure to state precisely (edit if it changed).
fields.help: JD is remote with a London option; no 'immediate start' signal found, so this is optional to include.
